scope: Review and deliver the existing token-free Node installer through the Go panel; actual node installation remains user-owned.

plan.task: Review and merge the five existing Node installer commits; exclude unrelated diagnostics
Close installer and xbctl upgrade panel-provider gaps; test no-token metadata/download and secure endpoints
Restore panel immutable release routes, isolated release-root configuration and no-gh enrollment command with security regression tests
Publish CI-verified v1.14.4 Node binaries and embed a checksum-pinned release bundle in the panel image
Merge the Go changes, build exact image and update internal-test panel by CI with backup and scoped rollback
Verify public metadata, installer checksum, generated command and preserved Remnawave services; leave node installation to user

non_goals: No proxy kernel or accounting protocol changes
No unrelated local Node diagnostics commit
No GitHub credentials on node servers
delivery_design: Node private source remains in Node repository. Only verified CI release binaries and installer are mirrored to a public Go release for checksum-pinned Docker builds. The runtime serves its immutable bundled release; no GitHub token is injected into the panel or nodes.
production_update: CI-only image replacement of the existing Xboard container. Preserve Compose, volumes, credentials, Caddy route and other containers. Create and verify a database backup first; restore previous image/configuration on failed health or release probes.

node_delivery.pr_ci_result: success: Linux race, installer tests, reachable vulnerability scan, amd64/arm64 binaries and Docker build
node_delivery.security_fix: Go 1.26.8, grpc 1.83.2, x/crypto 0.56.0 with required module dependencies; no kernel business logic change
